blocks.text: 发布前，我们依据 Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework 对 Muse Ember 进行了评估，涵盖化学与生物、网络安全以及失控风险。在所评估的各类别中，我们的评估发现 Muse Ember 均低于该框架的高风险阈值。尽管它是一款小模型，但同样接受了核心安全训练与测试。我们还评估了 Muse Ember 代表用户行事时的表现，包括它是否尊重用户意图、是否妥善处理敏感信息、能否抵御网页、文档或工具输出中试图改变其行为的隐藏指令，以及是否会在采取高影响操作前征求人类意见。

blocks.text: 当初推出 Muse Wonder 和 Muse Wonder Full 时，我们说过会用它们来开发能带给所有人的专用模型。Muse Ember 就是第一个用 Muse Wonder Full 训练出来的模型。它补齐了我们的模型阵容：Muse Wonder 负责最难的问题，Muse Spark 负责编程和智能体工作流，Muse Ember 则负责大规模、可重复的编程和智能体任务，在 Artificial Analysis 上每项任务成本约 0.14 美元，低到足以让每个产品、每个人都用得起。

blocks.text: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing.

blocks.text: “On the Box AI Complex Work Eval, Muse Ember delivers impressive accuracy, speed and token efficiency. It can score a contract against a company's negotiation playbook clause by clause and land on the right overall risk rating, or screen candidates against a detailed brief and flag the borderline ones who still qualify as alternates. Muse Ember is a fast, efficient foundation for agents doing real work on enterprise content.”

blocks.text: Before release, we evaluated Muse Ember under our Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework, including chemical and biological, cybersecurity, and loss-of-control risks. Across the categories assessed, our evaluations found that Muse Ember remained below the framework’s high-risk thresholds. Though it’s a small model, it received the same core safety training and testing. We also evaluated how Muse Ember behaves when acting on users' behalf. That covers whether it respects user intent, handles sensitive information appropriately, resists instructions hidden in web pages, documents, or tool outputs that try to redirect it, and seeks human input before high-impact actions.

inlines.text: Before release, we evaluated Muse Ember under our Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework, including chemical and biological, cybersecurity, and loss-of-control risks. Across the categories assessed, our evaluations found that Muse Ember remained below the framework’s high-risk thresholds. Though it’s a small model, it received the same core safety training and testing. We also evaluated how Muse Ember behaves when acting on users' behalf. That covers whether it respects user intent, handles sensitive information appropriately, resists instructions hidden in web pages, documents, or tool outputs that try to redirect it, and seeks human input before high-impact actions.

blocks.text: Muse Ember is available today on Muse Code and Meta Model API as muse-ember-1.0. It costs $0.10 per million input tokens, $0.004 per million cached input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, with a 1M-token context window and up to 512K output tokens. Muse Ember supports the Responses API.

blocks.text: When we introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, we said we would use them to develop specialized models we can bring to everyone. Muse Ember is the first trained using Muse Wonder Full. It rounds out our portfolio of models: Muse Wonder for the hardest problems, Muse Spark for coding and agentic workflows, and Muse Ember for repeatable coding and agentic tasks at scale at about $0.14 per Artificial Analysis task, a cost low enough to run in every product, for everyone.

inlines.text: When we introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, we said we would use them to develop specialized models we can bring to everyone. Muse Ember is the first trained using Muse Wonder Full. It rounds out our portfolio of models: Muse Wonder for the hardest problems, Muse Spark for coding and agentic workflows, and Muse Ember for repeatable coding and agentic tasks at scale at about $0.14 per Artificial Analysis task, a cost low enough to run in every product, for everyone.

blocks.text: Our goal is personal superintelligence: models that help you pursue your goals, create what you imagine, deepen your relationships, and take action on what you value most. Bringing it to everyone takes more than frontier capability. It takes frontier capability at a price that scales. We have even more efficient models in training and look forward to sharing what's next.
